card.name: The digit 1 after "the first"
card.fires_on: The digit 1 that begins a number right after "the first" in dosing or monitoring schedules. The number continues in the next piece, such as 12 weeks, 10 minutes or 1,000 mg.

modes.label: Time span
modes.description: A leading 1 after "the first" starting a duration like 12 weeks or 10 minutes.
modes.example: Monitor complete blood counts every 2 weeks for the first <<1>>2 weeks and monthly thereafter.

modes.label: Amount infused
modes.description: A leading 1 after "the first" starting a dose amount such as 1,000 mg or 100 mg.
modes.example: IRRs occurred predominantly during infusion of the first <<1>>,000 mg.

card.plain: It fires on the first digit 1 of a number that follows "the first", as in "the first 12 weeks" or "the first 10 minutes".
